data.body:
AC amendment: Default value for absent merge.strategy and unknown strategy test

Default: when merge.strategy key is absent from dso-config.conf, dispatcher defaults to 'direct' (backward compat for consumer projects upgrading plugin that haven't set the key). Emit one-time note to stderr: 'NOTE: merge.strategy not set in dso-config.conf, defaulting to direct. Add merge.strategy=direct to suppress this message.'

Unknown strategy test: add test_dispatcher_rejects_unknown_strategy function to tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh before implementing the dispatcher. This test should: create tmpdir with merge.strategy=unknown_value, run dispatcher, assert exit 1 AND stderr contains 'unknown_value' AND stderr contains valid values. Add RED marker to .test-index: 'tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh [test_dispatcher_rejects_unknown_strategy]'. After dispatcher implementation, this test becomes GREEN.

Add AC: 'test_dispatcher_rejects_unknown_strategy passes: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh 2>&1 | grep -q test_dispatcher_rejects_unknown_strategy.*PASS'
